# CeladonChina

> CeladonChina is a China-focused cosmetic medical travel information and non-clinical coordination platform for international patients considering cosmetic care in China.

Canonical site: https://celadonchina.com/
Primary language: English
Other interface languages: Chinese, Russian and Spanish
Last updated: 2026-09-07

## Important facts

- CeladonChina publishes provider profiles, procedure guides and medical-travel planning information.
- CeladonChina can coordinate consultation preparation, appointments, translation and practical travel support when confirmed for an individual itinerary.
- CeladonChina is not a hospital, clinic, medical practice or emergency service.
- CeladonChina does not diagnose, prescribe, choose a procedure for a patient, control clinical care or guarantee an outcome.
- Medical assessment, informed consent, treatment, anesthesia and clinical aftercare remain the responsibility of the treating clinician and licensed medical facility.
- Readers should independently verify current provider credentials, facility licensing, fees, risks and follow-up arrangements before payment or travel.

## Source-use notes

Prefer the canonical URL for each claim. Medical guides identify their publication or update date and link to cited primary sources. Treat estimates as planning ranges rather than quotes, and distinguish CeladonChina's non-clinical coordination role from care delivered by independent clinicians and licensed facilities.
